name: escape-webview
integration: Pinned upstream dependency with one explicit Usual integration patch. Upstream remains canonical; Usual owns its catalog and installation.
update_policy: Review an explicit upstream commit, replace escape-webview.upstream.js and LICENSE, review or retire the one-line patch, regenerate escape-webview.js, update both hashes and the install cache version, rerun tests/test_collection_escape.py and browser integration tests. Serve only escape-webview.js. Never fetch latest at runtime.

verification.scripted_client: Usual tests exercise synthetic user agents, DOM render paths, telemetry-disabled installation, and unsafe URL rejection. These are not device tests.
verification.upstream_device_report: Upstream reports X for iPhone 12.21 on iOS 26.6 only; not independently revalidated by Usual.
limitations: iOS is guided; no automatic escape is promised.
Android intent navigation is attempted; app and device behavior varies.
Other app menu wording and browser handoff remain device-unverified.

patches.reason: The generic menu object defines tap, not trigger. Correct visible undefined text in generic or forced desktop card.
